summary: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 19, 2026, disclosing a proposed private offering of $300 million aggregate principal amount of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032 to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A, with an optional $45 million greenshoe. The proceeds will be used to preserve financial flexibility for international expansion (including the proposed acquisition of Eucalyptus), AI-driven platform investment, and technology infrastructure. This is a capital markets financing transaction, not a special situation event—it is an ordinary convertible note offering to raise funds for general corporate purposes and strategic growth. No premium, price per share, or board recommendation is applicable. Routine 8-K, thus categorized as None.
